svg.text: Idle sawmill: the log saw (row 1), four ideas (idle, three frames of work in a loop, done)
a blue tunnel; a cutter head on its side turns and throws chips into a bin; the trunk goes in round, comes out square
an open gantry with two big toothed discs either side of the lane, sawdust flies; the easiest to read as "a saw"
two tall band saws stand beside the lane, the teeth run down the blade; looks like a real sawmill
the sibling of the round-hole debarker ring: a box with a square hole, four small saws round it; the round trunk goes in, the square one comes out
